The candidate will initially work within established Patient Analytics processes and collaborate closely with onshore and offshore teams to support recurring and ad hoc analyses. The role will also contribute to improving scripting, standardizing methodologies, automating repetitive activities, and strengthening the overall delivery process. Assignments may include Source of Business analyses, indication splits, patient journeys, and other rule-based patient analytics, depending on project requirements.

**Essential Functions**

1. Patient Analytics & Programming

* Perform hands-on analysis of large healthcare and patient-level datasets.

* Translate analytical requirements and business rules into efficient, reusable scripts.

* Support use cases such as Source of Business, indication splits, persistency, dosing, patient journeys, patient segmentation, and other longitudinal analyses.

* Apply rule-based methodologies to classify patients and derive required analytical outputs.

* Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of results.

* Troubleshoot analytical or data issues and independently investigate potential solutions.

2. Project Delivery

* Support recurring and ad hoc Patient Analytics projects for stakeholders.

* Take ownership of analytical activities from requirement understanding through scripting, QC, output generation, and packaging.

* Work effectively across projects with varying delivery cycles and manage higher workloads around critical delivery periods.

* Ensure outputs are delivered accurately, consistently, and according to agreed timelines.

* Maintain clear documentation of analytical logic, assumptions, and methodologies.

3. Process Improvement & Automation

* Understand and initially operate within existing delivery processes, technologies, and methodologies to ensure continuity.

* Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing scripts and workflows without disrupting established delivery.

* Develop reusable code, templates, and standardized approaches where appropriate.

* Explore opportunities for automation, improved QC, and more efficient delivery as familiarity with the processes grows and constructively challenge the legacy analytical approach.

* Contribute to the longer-term evolution of Patient Analytics capabilities and technology.

4. Business & Analytical Understanding

* Understand stakeholder questions and translate them into clearly defined analytical requirements.

* Develop an understanding of the business context behind Patient Analytics methodologies rather than treating activities purely as programming tasks.

* Interpret analytical outputs and highlight relevant findings, exceptions, or data issues.

* Develop familiarity with healthcare data, methodologies, and market-specific requirements over time.

5. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

* Work closely with stakeholders and existing global delivery teams.

* Collaborate with analysts and consultants across geographically distributed teams to understand current methodologies and delivery practices.

* Communicate analytical questions, risks, and dependencies clearly and proactively.

**This is where** your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

**Your Role at Baxter**

  
  

Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories.

This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care.

  
  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  
  

* Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements.
* Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1.
* Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17.
* Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions.
* Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18.
* Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems.
* Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562.
* Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices.
* Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective.
* Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings.
* Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements.
* Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions.
* Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance.
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry.
* Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards.
* Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562.
* Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions.
* Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments.
* Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971.
* Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies.
* Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays.
* Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes.
* Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines.
* Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment.

description:
**Overview**
------------

The Recruitment Team Lead is responsible for leading recruitment delivery across the assigned region and business portfolio, ensuring achievement of hiring objectives, service levels, and stakeholder expectations. Working closely with the Regional Delivery Manager and Regional Business Partners, the role drives recruitment strategy and operational excellence to support business growth.

**Your role**
-------------

* Responsible for leading and managing team of recruiters, establishing clear priorities, expectations and accountability across assigned business areas, region and hiring portfolios.
* Work closely with the Hiring managers, Recruitment Partner, Sourcing Team, Talent attraction and Talent Acquisition Operations teams to apply best practice, drive continuous improvement and mobilize (internal & external) resourcing strategies to reduce overall time-to-hire and drive hiring success.
* Lead the team's delivery against agreed SLAs and KPIs by proactively monitoring recruiter productivity, pipeline health, funnel conversion and stakeholder experience metrics.
* Drive operational excellence across the respective business by identifying and resolving process inefficiencies and bottlenecks; continuously improving delivery through data-driven recommendations with global consistency with regional and business-specific requirements.
* Build and lead a high performing recruitment team by raising the capability and accountability; driving rapid skill development and cultivating recruiters to manage complex hiring challenges, influence stakeholders, and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Lead data quality governance, monitor recruitment metrics and dashboards to identify trends, coach recruiters on best system practices, and partner with cross-functional teams to optimize reporting, workflow efficiency, compliance, and operational decision-making.
* Drive Compliance, Governance & Data Privacy excellence adhering to global recruitment processes. Understand data privacy standards, manage audit readiness, proactively escalate policy breaches, compliance risks and control failures.
* Act as the primary escalation point for recruitment delivery challenges, stakeholder concerns, process issues and workload conflicts. Intervene in complex stakeholder situations and restore confidence. implement process enhancements and strengthen operational controls to monitor performance.
* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of all recruitment activity within Workday and connected systems. Provide regular team-level performance updates, workload insights, quality observations, risk indicators, and improvement recommendations to the Recruitment Delivery Manager / Manager – People Hub.
* Foster a high-performance, high-accountability recruitment culture by setting clear expectations. Build recruiter capability through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, process refreshers, peer learning, quality calibration, and reinforcement of customer-focused recruitment delivery behaviours.

**About you**
-------------

* 12+ years of Talent Acquisition experience, with a strong track record of delivering recruitment outcomes across complex, high-volume hiring environments.
* 5 years proven track record in managing mid to large teams, 5-10 members minimum and experience recruiting in a corporate, professional services, consulting, or high-tech industry.
* Prior experience of working in a Recruitment Managed Service environment (preferably international support), RPO (recruitment process outsourcing) or an in-house recruitment team is essential.
* Proven experience partnering with senior business leaders and hiring managers, influencing hiring decisions, workforce planning, and recruitment strategy.
* Customer focus, Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Can build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels.
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, capable of interpreting recruitment metrics
* Resilient, driven, highly organized with the ability to identify and focus on priorities and deliver to deadlines.
* Hands-on experience with ATS and recruitment technologies, preferably Workday Recruiting, CRM platforms, recruitment analytics tools, and sourcing technologies.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office suite.
* Candidate should be flexible to work in UK shifts.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

* Company gratuity scheme.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**Overview**

We are 270+ talents operating under one Hub; diversified into different process groups - Recruitment, Lifecyle, Offboarding, Service Excellence and Contact Management. We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. The future focussed HR organisation largely possess a strong Onshore Partnering Team and the Centre of Excellence, complimented by a robust Service Delivery Team offering top class services to employees from the HR People Hub, Bangalore.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Business Partner who has experience in connecting business strategy with talent delivery, ensuring future workforce needs are identified early and addressed through an integrated regional recruitment approach

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Strategic Workforce Planning & Pipeline Development**

* Partner with regional Win Work / Business Development teams and workforce planning leads to understand future demand driven by projects bid, won, or anticipated.
* Translate business strategy, project pipelines, attrition trends, and retirement patterns into forward‑looking talent and sourcing strategies.
* Identify and prioritise critical skills and roles requiring proactive pipelining or market engagement.
* Act as a thought partner to the business on talent risk, supply constraints, and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure external executive hiring is planned, justified, and aligned to organisational strategy and workforce plans.
* Work in close partnership with the HR Business Partners / HR Ops aligned to supported business areas to ensure talent strategy, workforce planning, organisational design, and people interventions are fully aligned. Provide talent insight, market intelligence, and forward‑looking workforce data to inform business planning, change initiatives, and investment decisions, acting as a trusted advisor on skills availability, capability risk, and talent implications of strategic change.

**Data, Insight & Talent Intelligence**

* Leverage CRM, ATS, and workforce analytics to identify patterns in hiring demand, attrition, retirement, and movement.
* Use insight to inform strategic workforce planning, sourcing strategies, and employer branding priorities.
* Provide clear, compelling storytelling through data, maintaining confidentiality and appropriate governance over sensitive information.
* Actively challenge assumptions using evidence‑based insights and external market intelligence.

**Integration Across Brand & Marketing / Sourcing**

* Serve as a strategic feeder of demand, insight, and priorities into Brand and Marketing / Sourcing teams, ensuring alignment to future workforce needs.
* Influence campaign focus, messaging, and investment decisions based on anticipated skill shortages or strategic growth areas.
* Work closely with sourcing teams to shape proactive pipelining strategies aligned to long‑term demand.

**People Hub (offshore / nearshore) Alignment**

* Act as the strategic partner to the offshore / nearshore People Hub, setting clear expectations, priorities, and success measures. Move the interaction from hands‑on firefighting to structured performance management and governance, ensuring delivery is effective while reinforcing that day‑to‑day issue resolution and escalation is owned locally by the senior recruiters.
* Maintain oversight of regional headcount budgets, ensuring recruitment activity aligns to approved funding and resource models.
* Ensure effective utilisation and performance of offshore or shared service recruitment delivery models.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Experience**

* Operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the business, providing challenge, guidance, and strategic insight on talent decisions.

* Conduct structured talent health checks with business leaders to assess delivery effectiveness, pipeline health, and future readiness.
* Gather and act on feedback from both candidates and hiring stakeholders to continuously improve the recruitment experience.

KEY KPIs / SUCCESS MEASURES

The Strategic Talent Partner demonstrates value through measurable, strategic impact rather than volume based

metrics alone. Success is evidenced by:

**Strategic Impact**

* Clear linkage between workforce plans, project pipelines, and recruitment activity.
* Reduction in reactive or last‑minute hiring for critical roles through proactive pipelining.
* Improved readiness for projects won, with reduced time‑to‑mobilise critical skills.

**Data**‑**Led Decision Making**

* Delivery of high‑quality, actionable talent insights used by business and HR leaders to inform decisions.
* Demonstrated use of CRM and workforce data to predict demand and identify risks.
* Positive stakeholder feedback on the clarity and usefulness of talent intelligence provided.

**Pipeline & Sourcing Effectiveness**

* Strength and conversion rates of future‑focused talent pipelines for priority roles.
* Reduced reliance on contingency hiring or urgent executive search due to improved forward planning.
* Alignment between employer brand activity and future skills priorities.

**Governance & Financial Discipline**

* High adherence to headcount budgets and workforce governance processes.
* Effective oversight, accountability and partnership of the delivery of offshore/nearshore shared service delivery.

* Improved stakeholder satisfaction scores linked to recruitment partnership and insight.
* Positive candidate feedback, particularly for senior and specialist hiring journeys.
* Strong, trusted relationships with business leaders, HR partners, and recruitment delivery teams.

DECISION RIGHTS & SCOPE

* Recommends regional hiring priorities for assigned business areas.
* Determines the focus of pipeline, sourcing, and employer brand activity within approved priorities and budgets.
* Sets operating expectations and escalation protocols for supporting TA delivery teams.
* Challenges demand assumptions and propose trade-offs in timing, channels, or resource allocation.
* Does not approve unbudgeted headcount, compensation exceptions, or deviations from global TA policy.
* Escalates material workforce, financial, compliance, or service risks to the accountable leader.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS & INTERFACES

* **Business leaders and hiring managers:** Align on workforce demand, hiring priorities, trade-offs, and decision timelines.
* **HR Business Partners and workforce planning:** Connect business plans, organisational changes, and workforce risks to talent actions.
* **Regional and global TA leadership:** Align priorities, governance, capacity, standards, and escalations.
* **Recruitment delivery, sourcing, and People Hub teams:** Coordinate execution, hand-offs, market feedback, and service performance.
* **Employer Brand, Marketing, TA Operations, Analytics, and Technology:** Enable campaigns, data insight, process compliance, systems, and candidate experience.
* **External talent partners:** Engage agencies, platforms, professional networks, and education partners when approved and required.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

* Substantial Talent Acquisition experience in a complex, matrixed organisation.

* Working knowledge of labour markets, talent research methods, and candidate relationship management.
* Proficiency with ATS, CRM, workforce dashboards, and recruitment analytics.
* Experience within regional, shared service, offshore, or nearshore delivery models.
* Ability to prepare concise executive updates, recommendations, and presentations in a business environment.

CORE COMPETENCIES & BEHAVIOURS

* **Commercial judgement:** Weighs urgency, cost, quality, feasibility, and business risk.
* **Constructive influence:** Builds trust, challenges respectfully, and secures commitment.
* **Analytical curiosity:** Tests assumptions and identifies patterns, causes, and implications.
* **Execution discipline:** Follows through, documents decisions, and closes actions.
* **Collaborative ownership:** Works across boundaries while respecting role accountabilities.

**Job Overview**  
  
  

The Payroll & Benefits Specialist will help us manage and execute our payroll and benefits programs. Reporting to the Director, Talent in India, this role will focus on administering and executing payroll and benefits processes. We are looking for a stellar candidate with strong execution skills, who is well-versed with industry insights and practical knowledge on all payroll and benefits matters.

  
  
**About Us**  
  
  

ICIMS is a leading enterprise hiring platform that combines the scale and reliability of enterprise software with the transformative power of AI. Thousands of organizations across more than 200 countries and territories trust ICIMS to find and hire the people who shape their future and drive their business forward. Powered by insights from billions of hiring interactions, continuous AI innovation, and a highly extensible platform, ICIMS helps organizations turn talent acquisition into a competitive advantage. For more than 25 years, ICIMS has delivered end-to-end hiring solutions that improve recruiting efficiency, reduce costs and create exceptional candidate experiences.

ICIMS helps solve one of the biggest challenges businesses face today: building a workforce that can adapt, scale, and perform in an increasingly competitive and unpredictable talent market. We uniquely do that by combining enterprise-grade hiring technology, AI-powered insights and automation, and connected talent experiences to help organizations improve hiring outcomes while driving measurable impact.

  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
  

* Responsible for delivering agreed payroll and benefits programs for India, ensuring our programs conform with local market practices and follow legal requirements.
* Manage relationships with relevant vendors and client groups aligned to payroll and benefits.
* Maintain detailed project management plans for the implementation of identified payroll and benefits programs in India, including the implementation and maintenance of these processes and programs, and support the review of new proposals.
* Effectively manage payroll operations for India – payroll inputs, adjustments, off-cycle payments reconciliation, and advising and monitoring effective and timely operations working with the payroll vendor.
* Manage and advise on payroll-related compliances working with vendors and internal teams.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records, collaborate with the internal team in periodic audits, and ensure proper statutory deductions including income tax, provident fund, employee state insurance, professional tax, and other applicable contributions in compliance with Indian labor laws.
* Manage the day-to-day administration of our wellness and benefits offerings. Conduct benefits benchmarking and share findings to support reviews of our benefits offerings against our employer value proposition.
* Present the payroll and benefits overview in relevant forums (new hire orientation, employee sessions, etc.) and address all employee queries as a point person.
* Work closely with all vendors (medical, payroll, benefits) in addressing issues in the moment and helping us create an optimal employee experience.
* Recommend and implement improvements to payroll and benefits processes and systems, document the processes for internal and external stakeholders. Provide guidance/training to the Tier I team on various payroll/benefits-related inquiries.
* Participate in system upgrades, testing, and configuration of HRIS/payroll modules.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and enhance payroll and benefits processes, including HRIS/payroll system integrations, upgrades, testing and implementations.

  
**Qualifications**  
  
  

* Graduation from any business school with a human resource or business-related degree.
* 4-6 years of experience working in the HR domain with at least 3 years' experience focused on managing payroll and benefits programs for India.
* Strong hands-on experience in end-to end India payroll processing, payroll compliance, taxation and statutory requirements.
* Experience working for international companies with payroll and benefits experience; a consulting background is preferable.
* Strong communication skills, able to influence stakeholders with compelling data analysis and storytelling.
* Expertise in budgeting, vendor assessment, data requirement gathering, project management, and process documentation & governance.
* Strong networks and connections within peer companies.
* Thorough understanding of the market landscape and practices in the payroll and benefits space.
* Experience solving complex payroll and benefits problems, implementing practical process improvements, and delivering results with specialist domain knowledge and technical expertise in payroll and benefits.
* Experience managing vendor-related implementations, change management, and implementation.
* Working knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, payroll systems, and HRIS platforms, with strong excel and analytical skills
* Analytical bias, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to analyze data trends and themes.
* Comfortable with complex data, with a strength in using Excel and strong data analytical skills.
* Able to demonstrate confidence, influence, and credibility.
* Able to work under pressure and maintain attention to detail.
* Strong focus on optimizing for technology and efficiency.

  
**EEO Statement**  
  
  

ICIMS is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at ICIMS. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you’d like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at careers@icims.com.

  
  
**Compensation and Benefits**  
  
  

Competitive health and wellness benefits include medical insurance (employee and dependent family members), personal accident and group term life insurance, bonding and parental leave, lifestyle spending account reimbursements, wellness services offerings, sick and casual/emergency days, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, retirals (PF - employer contribution) and gratuity. Benefits and eligibility may vary by location, role, and tenure. Learn more here: https://careers.icims.com/benefits

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

As a Service Desk Analyst, you will report to the IT Team Lead - Service Desk and act as the first point of contact for IT support across our organisation. In this role, you will provide prompt, courteous, and effective assistance to colleagues, resolving common technical issues and fulfilling service requests while ensuring an excellent customer experience.

You will play a vital part in supporting day-to-day continuity for a dynamic workforce. Responsibilities include triaging and resolving basic incidents, accurately logging and categorising tickets, and escalating

complex issues to 2nd and 3rd line teams when necessary. Clear communication, empathy, technical expertise, and adherence to security and operational standards will be key to your success.

Collaboration is central to this role. You will work closely with colleagues across IT support tiers, contributing to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. With a focus on service excellence and professional growth, you will have opportunities to develop technical and interpersonal skills, support digital transformation initiatives, and help enhance employee satisfaction and operational resilience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the first point of contact for IT support, providing prompt and professional resolution for incidents and fulfilment of service requests.

* Deliver exceptional customer service by listening actively, empathising, and communicating clearly and professionally.

* Resolve incidents and service requests efficiently, ensuring colleagues feel supported throughout the process.

* Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and known issues.

* Apply your growing knowledge of IT systems, networks, and common applications to troubleshoot effectively.

* Adhere to established procedures and escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate support level promptly.

* Collaborate with other IT teams to ensure seamless service delivery and foster knowledge sharing.

* Proactively seek feedback and identify opportunities to improve service quality and employee satisfaction.

* Uphold SLAs and compliance requirements while driving service excellence.

* Demonstrate initiative in learning new technologies and enhancing both technical and interpersonal skills.

Personal attributes

* Exhibits a strong customer service mindset, demonstrating empathy, patience, and professionalism in every interaction.

* Communicates clearly and confidently, actively listening to colleague needs and explaining technical issues in an accessible, reassuring manner.

description:
This is a remote position.

**Company:** Blessed Accountants of GA, Inc. (BFG Tax) | **Location:** India, remote (Kochi preferred; qualified applicants

across India welcome)

  

**Engagement**: Independent consultant, fixed-fee project | **Initial duration**: Approximately 4-6 weeks

Reports to: Founder & CEO | Collaborates with: Finance, Delivery, Marketing, Sales and U.S. Securities & Corporate

Attorney

  

**1. About BFG Tax**

BFG Tax is a U.S.-based accounting, tax, payroll and financial advisory business established in 2004. The company is

planning industry-focused expansion supported by marketing, customer acquisition, technology, strategic partnerships and

centralized service delivery.

  

**2. Position Overview**

  

We seek a hands-on fractional CFO or corporate finance specialist in India to develop investor-ready financial models,

forecasts, valuation scenarios and capital requirements for a U.S. private fundraising initiative. This is not a routine

bookkeeping, tax compliance or accounting management position.

  

**3. Fundraising Project**

  

Stage Proposed funding objective

1 - Existing client relationships $50,000-$100,000

2 - Additional private investors Balance required to reach $250,000 cumulative

3 - Potential subsequent round $750,000

Overall potential financing Up to $1,000,000

Management is considering business loans, equity and convertible notes for the initial financing. The CFO will evaluate

financial implications; U.S. legal counsel will determine legal feasibility and securities compliance. The CFO must

independently assess whether proposed funding amounts are appropriate.

  

**4. Key Responsibilities**

  

A. Historical Financial Review

* Review historical income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, liabilities and operating costs.

* Reconcile records supplied by the Finance Manager; identify gaps and material assumptions.

* Separate recurring, one-time, seasonal and project-based revenue and analyze revenue by service.

* Assess cash balances, outstanding loans, working capital and U.S.-India cost arrangements.

B. Financial Modeling and Forecasting

* Build an integrated, formula-driven and editable Microsoft Excel financial model.

  

BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 2

* Prepare monthly 2027 forecasts, detailed January-June 2027 cash flow, a rolling 13-week cash forecast, and three-year

projections.

* Produce conservative, base and growth scenarios, break-even, cash runway and sensitivity analysis.

* Document data sources, drivers, assumptions and model checks.

C. Marketing and Customer Acquisition

* Model the proposed January-June 2027 advertising budget of $155,000, subject to approval.

* Analyze lead costs, lead qualification, conversion, onboarding, acquisition costs and recurring-revenue timing.

* Test retention, service delivery costs, contribution margin and alternative marketing spend levels.

D. Capital Requirements and Use of Funds

* Determine minimum viable capital needs and recommended financing schedule.

* Produce use-of-funds and liquidity scenarios for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.

* Assess operating reserves, funding milestones, and the timing and need for a later $750,000 round.

E. Financing Alternatives

* Compare business loans, equity and convertible notes.

* Model debt service, repayment, interest, dilution, conversion and subsequent fundraising effects.

* Coordinate with securities counsel on S corporation constraints and permissible instruments; do not provide legal opinions.

F. Valuation and Investor Materials

* Prepare supportable valuation methodologies and pre-/post-money capitalization scenarios.

* Clearly distinguish total annual revenue from recurring revenue.

* Prepare financial exhibits, risks, assumptions, sensitivities and presentation-ready schedules.

  

**5. Required Deliverables**

  

* Historical financial review and findings memorandum.

* Fully editable, integrated Excel model with transparent assumptions and formulas.

* January-June 2027 cash-flow forecast and rolling 13-week cash forecast.

* Three-year financial projections and conservative/base/growth scenarios.

* Marketing and customer acquisition model.

* Use-of-funds schedules for $50,000, $100,000 and $250,000.

* Debt, equity and convertible-note financial comparison.

* Valuation, capitalization and dilution scenarios.

* Investor-ready financial summary and supporting exhibits.

* Written recommendations on funding amount, timing and financial risks.

* Management presentation and handover of all model files.

  

**6. Required Qualifications**

  

* CA, CPA, CFA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent professional qualification; preferably 10+ years relevant experience.

* Proven investor-ready modeling work for U.S. businesses, including financial statements and cash-flow analysis.

* Advanced Excel skills, valuation, capitalization and scenario modeling.

* Understanding of U.S. financial reporting and strong written/spoken English.

* Availability for scheduled U.S. Eastern Time meetings.

  

BFG Tax | Recruitment - Fractional CFO Page 3

  

**7. Preferred Experience**

  

* Fractional CFO or transaction advisory work for U.S. small and midsize businesses.

* Private fundraising, recurring-revenue economics and professional services businesses.

* U.S.-India outsourced operations and cross-border financial analysis.

* Investor/lender due diligence; familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks or Zoho Books.

  

**8. Timeline and Compensation**

  

The engagement is expected to last approximately 4-6 weeks. An initial financial assessment and preliminary model are

expected within 1-2 weeks, followed by iterative review and final delivery. Candidates should propose a realistic milestone

schedule and fixed-fee quote, identifying payment milestones, assumptions, exclusions, revision costs and possible ongoing

advisory support.

The consultant is not authorized to solicit investors, negotiate securities transactions or receive transaction-based fundraising

compensation under this engagement.

  

**9. Application Requirements**

  

* Resume or firm profile and summary of relevant U.S. work.

* Two or three comparable project examples; redacted model sample where permitted.

* Proposed approach, project timeline, fixed-fee quote and earliest start date.

* References from relevant U.S. or international clients where available.

  

**10. Selection Process**

  

Shortlisted applicants will complete a technical interview covering minimum funding requirements, marketing-led cash

forecasts, a $100,000 debt-versus-equity comparison, valuation and dilution, and investor due diligence. A short paid

modeling exercise may be used for finalists.

  

**11. Confidentiality and Ownership**

  

Engagement is subject to signed confidentiality and consulting agreements. All BFG-specific models and deliverables must

be handed over in editable form, with ownership and permitted reuse governed by contract. Confidential company, client,

employee and investor information must be handled under approved security procedures.

Bengaluru, India | Full time | Hybrid | R1581187

  

Associate Consultant | Commercial Strategy Consulting

Start your consulting career where strategy, data and life sciences come together.

Your Opportunity at IQVIA

What if your first role could help shape how life sciences companies enter new markets, launch products, understand patients, evaluate investments and make critical growth decisions?

As an Associate Consultant in Commercial Strategy Consulting at IQVIA, you will work on real-world business challenges for organizations across the healthcare and life sciences industry.

You will combine structured problem solving, research, data analysis and strategic thinking to turn complex questions into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Working alongside experienced consultants and cross-functional teams, you will gain exposure to diverse projects and stakeholders.

This is an opportunity to begin your career in Management Consulting while developing deep expertise in one of the world's most dynamic and purpose-driven industries: life sciences.

What Could You Work On?

Your projects could involve helping healthcare and life sciences organizations answer questions such as:



Go-to-Market Strategy - Analyze markets, customers and competitors to help develop effective commercialization strategies.



Market & Portfolio Assessment - Evaluate market attractiveness, growth opportunities, competitive dynamics and potential portfolio choices.



Commercial Due Diligence - Bring together market research, data and strategic analysis to support critical business decisions.



Patient Journey - Use healthcare data and research to identify important insights across the patient journey and uncover opportunities to improve outcomes.



Forecasting & Analogue Analysis - Analyze historical trends, market dynamics and comparable products to support forecasts and strategic planning.



Market Access - Support engagements that explore the commercial and market considerations influencing access to healthcare products

What You Will Do

As an Associate Consultant, you will learn how consultants take an ambiguous business question and transform it into a structured recommendation.

You will:



Solve complex business problems using structured thinking, research and analysis.



Analyze healthcare data from IQVIA and other relevant data sources to uncover trends and insights.

* Conduct secondary research on markets, companies, competitors, therapies and

industry trends.

* Translate data into the "So what?", identifying what an insight actually means for the

client's business.

* Develop compelling PowerPoint presentations, analyses and recommendations for

project teams and stakeholders.

* Participate in project discussions and contribute your perspectives and insights.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams with opportunities to present findings to

project stakeholders.



* Take ownership of defined workstreams, managing quality and timelines.

* Identify potential risks, data gaps and emerging issues and communicate them

proactively.

* Contribute to high-quality client deliverables in a dynamic consulting environment.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for students who are curious, analytical, ambitious and excited by the idea of

solving difficult business problems.

Education

Graduate degree in:

* Life Sciences

* Engineering

* Or another relevant discipline

You Could Be a Great Fit If You...

* Love solving problems - You enjoy taking unstructured questions and breaking it down

logically.

* Are curious about business - You want to understand why companies grow, how

markets evolve and what drives competitive advantage.

* Enjoy working with data - You are comfortable exploring information, finding patterns

and using evidence to reach conclusions.

* Ask "So what?" - You don't stop at finding the answer. You want to understand what the

answer means and what someone should do next.

* Think in a structured way - You can organize complex information into a clear and

compelling story.

* Communicate effectively - You can articulate your thinking clearly through

conversations, presentations and written communication.

* Enjoy learning quickly - You are comfortable getting up to speed on unfamiliar topics,

markets and business problems.

* Take ownership - You are proactive, dependable and committed to delivering highquality

work.

* Thrive in teams - You enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines,

locations and perspectives.

Skills That Will Help You Succeed

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

* Critical and structured thinking

* Research and data interpretation skills

* Strong written and verbal communication

* Effective presentation and storytelling skills

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, project-based environment

* Interest in business, healthcare, life sciences and market trends

* Ability to understand how broader economic and market developments can influence

industries and companies

* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel is an advantage

Prior consulting experience is not essential. What matters most is your curiosity, analytical

mindset, willingness to learn and ability to turn information into insight.

Why IQVIA?

At IQVIA, you won't simply analyze a business problem. You will have the opportunity to

understand the intersection of:

Strategy + Healthcare + Data + Technology + Human Science

You can build capabilities highly valued across the consulting industry:

Structured Problem Solving | Commercial Strategy | Data Analysis | Market Research |

Storytelling | Client Communication | Healthcare Expertise

You will also have the opportunity to:

* Gain global exposure by collaborating with teams and stakeholders across

geographies.

* Work on meaningful problems facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.

* Learn through data and develop an evidence-based approach to strategy.

* Build consulting skills early through hands-on project experience.



Develop a differentiated career profile combining management consulting capabilities with healthcare expertise.

Your Consulting Career Can Start Here.

If you are someone who enjoys asking why, finding answers in data, challenging assumptions and turning complex information into clear recommendations, we would like to meet you.

Bring your curiosity. Build your consulting toolkit. Help shape the future of healthcare.

Apply to join IQVIA as an Associate Consultant, Commercial Strategy Consulting.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

**Where you'll work**
---------------------

### **Hybrid**

You’ll split your time between home and the office, giving you the flexibility to focus where you work best while still building strong in-person connections with your team. This model combines the autonomy of remote work with the collaboration, energy and resources of an office environment.

  

**Culture**
-----------

Culture at IQVIA is built on a shared belief: that when people are empowered with better data, smarter technology and deeper expertise, they can change what’s possible for patients. Across every team and every corner of the globe, you’ll find colleagues who genuinely care — about the mission and about each other. That’s what makes this a place where people tend to stay, grow and do the best work of their careers.

description:
**About the role**
------------------

Nexus is Corporater's new platform for managing leads, cases, partners and the sales pipeline, built in-house as a custom application on AWS.

As Tech Lead, you will lead a small team of two developers and one QA engineer. This is a hands-on role: around 70% of your time goes to designing and building, and around 30% to leading the team and working with stakeholders. You will work closely with the Product Owner and colleagues in Norway.

**Our stack:** Java and Spring Boot (modular monolith), React and TypeScript, Aurora PostgreSQL (with pgvector), Amazon ECS, SQS and EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Graph, Terraform, GitHub and OpenTelemetry.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Leading the team**

* Lead technical delivery with the team: break features into stories, estimate them, and agree scope and trade-offs with the Product Owner.
* Set up and own the team's engineering practices: coding standards, code review, Definition of Done, branching strategy and short decision records.
* Keep the modular monolith healthy: clear module boundaries, each module owning its data, and boundaries enforced by automated checks.
* Review code, coach the developers and make sure every module has more than one person who knows it.
* Run design workshops with the people who use Nexus and turn what you learn into working software.

### **Building and running the platform**

* Design and build core parts of Nexus: Leads and Cases, gates and status ladders, the pipeline board and forecast, dashboards per role, and master data administration.
* Own the versioned REST API, events and webhooks that tools and integrations use, with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, idempotency keys and a complete audit log.
* Design the integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive through Microsoft Graph, and with our HR, ERP, e-signature, marketing and support systems. Use queued, retried pushes (for example, a transactional outbox) so that no change is lost when a target system is down.
* Enforce access in the code: field and file visibility, partner access per agreement and Case, and server-side checks for the UI, API, add-in and SharePoint.
* Own the AWS environment: infrastructure as code in Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, environments, secrets, backups and cost tracking.
* Keep Nexus fast, reliable and observable: monitoring and alerting, load tests with the QA engineer, regular restore tests against agreed recovery targets, and runbooks.
* Build the single controlled AI service through which all AI model calls go, and help integrate it into the features that use it.

**What success looks like in the first 6 months**
-------------------------------------------------

* AWS environments, CI/CD, automated tests and monitoring in place and used by the whole team.
* Leads and Cases, with access control, audit log and Entra ID sign-in, in production use.
* The team working to agreed standards, with decision records for the key choices.

**What we are looking for**
---------------------------

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, including at least 3 years building and running production web services that real users depend on.
* Experience leading or guiding a small team of engineers while still writing a large share of the code yourself.
* Strong Java and Spring Boot skills, and working knowledge of TypeScript and React. You are comfortable working across the stack.
* Sound API and integration skills: REST design, OAuth 2.0 client credentials, webhooks, idempotency keys, and retries with back-off.
* Solid data modelling and experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including performance tuning, migrations and audit trails.
* Hands-on AWS experience: Containers, Lambda, queues and events, S3, IAM, a secrets service, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK). You have set up and run CI/CD pipelines yourself.
* A habit of testing: automated unit, integration and end-to-end tests, and load tests for the pages and APIs that matter.
* Security and privacy discipline: server-side access control, least privilege, personal data handling under GDPR, encryption and audit logs.
* The judgement to keep a design simple, with clear environments, ownership and monitoring.
* Clear written and spoken English. You can explain trade-offs to non-engineers and work well with colleagues and users in another country and time zone.
* Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to build with them, including using AI coding assistants with good judgement. You do not need to be an AI specialist.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Microsoft Graph experience with Outlook, Teams or SharePoint, or experience building an Outlook add-in.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including B2B guest users and single sign-on.
* Experience setting up a new team's engineering practices from scratch.
* Experience with event-driven designs, such as the outbox pattern.
* Knowledge of B2B sales processes, CRM systems or qualification frameworks such as MEDDPICC.
* Experience running one application across several regions with separate data residency.
* Hands-on experience with LLM features, for example Amazon Bedrock or retrieval (RAG) with pgvector.
* Experience with enterprise software for regulated industries, or with governance, risk and compliance products.

**Location:** India | **Function:** Tech Lead | **Experience:** 8+ years

**Why Join Corporater?**
------------------------

You will be part of the Product Engineering organization being built in Corporater India, working on a shared platform capability used across multiple global products.

You will solve interesting engineering problems across rich user experiences, component architecture, accessibility, performance, API integration, and enterprise-scale frontend development while having a direct influence on how the platform evolves.

If you enjoy solving meaningful engineering problems, building elegant user experiences, and want to build products rather than simply implement requirements, we would like to hear from you.

Ready to shape delivery excellence and lead talented consultants at Corporater?

Apply now by submitting your résumé and a brief cover letter through our recruitment portal. Please note that applications submitted by email will not be accepted.

️ We conduct all recruitment in-house and do not accept candidate submissions or CVs from recruitment agencies.

Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Benefits Administration, Technology teams, external advisers and service providers, the position converts workforce and rewards data into management insights and recommendations, while ensuring that C&B programs remain competitive, internally equitable, compliant, financially sustainable and aligned with business and talent priorities.

  

**Job Responsibilities**

  
  
  

**1. Compensation Management**

* Assist with the design, review and oversight of Base Pay, salary structures, allowances, variable pay and incentive arrangements.

* Review salary ranges periodically and support appropriate employee and job positioning within the compensation framework.

* Assess proposals for salary changes, new allowances, incentives, compensation plans and exceptions.

* Provide data-based compensation guidance to HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition and business leaders.

* Evaluate the compensation implications of organizational and business changes.

  
  

**2. Benefits Management**

* Assist with the design, review and periodic benchmarking of employee benefits, including Group Insurance, Provident Fund, Leaves, Car Lease, National Pension System, Gratuity, Employee State Insurance and wellness programs.

* Review benefit policies, eligibility rules, coverage limits and premium structures periodically to confirm competitiveness, cost effectiveness and statutory compliance.

* Assess proposals for new or revised benefits, policy exceptions and vendor changes, including their cost, employee impact and risk.

* Support annual insurance renewals with claims-experience analysis, premium and cost-impact modeling, and insurer and broker negotiations.

* Provide guidance to HR Business Partners and the Benefits Administration team on interpreting benefit policies and the impact of statutory changes.

  
  

**3. Market Benchmarking and Analytics**

* Coordinate annual compensation benchmarking and periodic benefits studies with external consulting partners.

* Perform job matching; mapping employees to the organization’s jobs/capabilities and to comparable market benchmark roles, so that compensation benchmarking studies can be conducted on a like-for-like basis.

* Analyze market data, salary ranges, internal equity and employee positioning to evaluate competitiveness.

* Translate compensation data into management insights, recommendations, dashboards and decision-support models.

* Maintain robust data-quality checks and reconciliation controls across C&B analyses.

  
  

**4. Strategic C&B Analytics and Management Reporting**

* Own a structured C&B reporting calendar and provide management dashboards, commentary and recommended actions rather than data-only reports.

* Produce annual market-pay benchmarking, market-ratio and rewards-competitiveness assessments to support pay philosophy, salary-range and investment decisions.

* Produce quarterly and compensation-cycle reporting on compa-ratio, range penetration, below-minimum and above-maximum populations, internal equity, gender pay gap, pay compression, new-hire versus incumbent pay, promotion increases, merit differentiation and pay position versus retention.

* Produce monthly or cycle-based reporting on compensation-budget utilization, budget versus actuals, benefits participation and utilization, payroll and benefits reconciliation outcomes and material policy or data exceptions.

* Analyze PF wage and contribution impacts, gratuity provisions, salary-structure compliance and the cost of regulatory changes, with increased reporting when statutory requirements change.

* Apply appropriate analytical methods, including percentile analysis, scenario modeling, correlation and regression-based pay-equity analysis, and clearly distinguish findings, assumptions, limitations and recommendations.

  
  

**5. Annual Compensation Planning**

* Coordinate activities across the annual merit and salary-review cycle.

* Support compensation budgeting, scenario modeling and preparation of employee-level recommendations.

* Validate proposed changes before implementation and coordinate approvals, communication, system updates and change-management activities.

* Provide plan interpretation, analytical review and governance for applicable incentive and variable-pay programs; validate eligibility, targets, payouts, funding and reconciliation outputs prepared by the administering teams.

  
  

**6. Total Rewards Strategy and Workforce Cost Management**

* Support the design and periodic review of the total rewards framework and employee value proposition, including pay philosophy, job architecture, grading and leveling structures, and benefit and recognition programs.

* Track market trends and emerging practices in pay, benefits, wellbeing and flexible rewards, and recommend relevant enhancements.

  
  

**7. Systems, Automation and Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate C&B activities, reduce manual effort and improve turnaround time.

**9. Governance, Audit, Controls and Risk Management**

* Provide high-level governance of compensation and benefits administration by periodically auditing whether the Compensation, Benefits Administration and Payroll teams follow approved SOPs across salary and incentive administration, Group Insurance, Provident Fund, National Pension System, Gratuity, Employee State Insurance and other benefit programs.

* Create and maintain SOPs for the Compensation, Benefits Administration and Payroll processes, in collaboration with the process teams that execute them, and govern maker-checker controls for the Payroll process, along with risk certifications and sustainable audit trails.

* Conduct periodic, risk-based reviews of sampled compensation changes, incentive payouts, benefit enrollments and premium validations, and of reconciliations completed by process teams, to confirm SOP adherence and documented approvals, and escalate exceptions and discrepancies to process owners for resolution.

* Monitor insurers, benefit vendors, consultants and service providers against agreed service levels and report governance findings to management.

* Support internal, external, statutory and process audits covering compensation and benefits, preparing reconciliations, evidence and responses and tracking observations through closure.

* Ability to use AI approved tools in day to day task

  
  
  

**Key Result Areas / Success Measures**

* Compensation cycle: Complete annual compensation planning accurately and within agreed timelines.

* Data accuracy: Ensure complete accuracy of C&B deliverables owned by the role and verify the accuracy of payroll and benefits outputs through controls and reviews.

* Market competitiveness: Use benchmarking insights to support competitive and internally equitable pay positioning.

* Strategic analytics and reporting: Deliver the agreed monthly, quarterly, annual and event-triggered C&B analysis calendar, clearly identifying material findings, financial implications, workforce risks and recommended management actions.

* Audit and controls: Close observations on time, minimize repeat findings, maintain complete documentation and audit trails, and keep Compensation, Benefits Administration and Payroll SOPs and maker-checker controls current and consistently applied.

* Employee experience: Provide timely and accurate resolution of escalated compensation and benefit queries.

About the Role

Machinify is seeking a Senior HR Systems Specialist to build and run the HR technology foundation for our new Bangalore business unit. Reporting to the Vice President of People Operations & Talent, this person will be the in-country expert on Workday and surrounding HR systems, including applicant tracking, learning, payroll, and time tracking, and will play a key, hands-on role in implementing Workday India. The role keeps India employee data, hiring, onboarding, payroll inputs, and reporting accurate, secure, and aligned with Machinify's global People systems.

You will partner closely with the U.S.-based People Operations and People Systems teams, Finance, IT, Legal, and external payroll and benefits providers, in a high-ownership launch environment as the Bangalore team grows from its first hires to scale.

What You Will Own

**WORKDAY ADMINISTRATION & CONFIGURATION**

* Serve as the India subject matter expert for Workday HCM, partnering with the VP on the implementation and owning day-to-day administration, configuration, and support for the Bangalore workforce.
* Provide Workday and other systems support to the U.S. workforce alongside the existing U.S. team, including reporting requests, configurations, talent and performance review administration, and employee changes.
* Configure and maintain business processes, security roles, calculated fields, reports, dashboards, and approval workflows, localized for India (legal entities, locations, calendars, leave types, statutory fields).
* Manage worker lifecycle transactions with a focus on data accuracy and audit readiness, and support semi-annual Workday release testing and communication.

**TALENT ACQUISITION & OTHER HR SYSTEMS**

* Administer and optimize Greenhouse (or a comparable applicant tracking system), including requisitions, scorecards, interview plans, offer approvals, and reporting, and maintain clean handoffs into Workday.
* Support learning management, payroll, and time and attendance systems, including user setup, pay-period data validation, and vendor issue resolution; evaluate additional HR tools as the team scales.

**INTEGRATIONS, DATA & REPORTING**

* Own data flows between Workday, the India payroll provider, benefits providers, and time tracking, running reconciliations and resolving exceptions each payroll cycle.
* Build People reporting and analytics (headcount, hiring funnel, time to fill, attrition, leave, compliance) and perform regular data-quality audits; document processes, controls, and runbooks.

**SECURITY, COMPLIANCE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT**

* Apply role-based security and privacy controls in line with Machinify policies and Indian data protection and employment requirements, including the DPDP Act, and support audits and access reviews with Legal, Compliance, and IT.
* Lead system projects and enhancements from requirements to rollout, train HR and business users, and keep India configurations aligned with global standards in close collaboration with the U.S. People Operations team.

**REQUIRED**

* 6+ years of HR systems, HRIS, or People Operations experience, including 3+ years of hands-on Workday HCM administration and configuration (Workday is mandatory).
* Working knowledge of Workday business processes, security, reporting (including advanced and composite reports), and integrations, with experience supporting a multi-country or global workforce.
* Experience with at least two additional HR systems across applicant tracking, learning management, payroll, and time and attendance.
* Understanding of HR processes and Indian employment practices (statutory payroll components, leave, compliance records), with the judgment to engage Legal when needed.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to balance hands-on execution with project ownership in a fast-paced, ambiguous launch environment.
* Exceptional written and verbal English communication; ability to work on-site in Bangalore and maintain working-hour overlap with U.S. teams.

**STRONGLY PREFERRED**

* Hands-on Greenhouse administration, including integration with Workday.
* Experience with Workday integrations (EIB, Studio, or Core Connectors) and India payroll vendor integrations; Workday certification or equivalent.
* Experience supporting teams that handle sensitive healthcare, financial, or other regulated data, ideally in healthcare technology.
* S./India cross-border experience across multiple time zones, ideally in a private-equity-backed, high-growth organization or a new India business unit or global capability center.
* Bachelor's degree in HR, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.

What We Offer

The opportunity to build the HR systems backbone for Machinify's Bangalore launch from the ground up, in a visible role with direct access to People leadership in India and the U.S., partnering with talented teams transforming healthcare through technology, data, and AI. Competitive compensation, locally relevant benefits, and professional-development opportunities in a flexible, trusting environment.

**Job Description :**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

**About the Function:**

Digital & Technology (D&T) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.

This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it’s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.

Working as one team, you'll learn, experiment and build on each other's ideas. By staying curious and embracing new ways of working, you'll help shape better outcomes for our business.

**About the role:**

Diageo have created a multi-functional Shared Services operation, combining our IS and DBS teams under the name of Diageo Business Service India. The ambition of DBSI is to become a World Class provider of Business Shared Services, delivering a brilliant customer experience and freeing our markets to achieve commercial excellence.

Within DBSI, the Business Shared Services function are responsible for delivering an efficient, standardised, compliant and scale-able transaction & analytic service to support market demand while also continuing the drive to create the efficient processes and develop new capabilities.

SAP Functional Consultants support the SAP Centre of Excellence (SAP CoE) and the Business Partners of each area who are accountable for the delivery of business strategic change programmes, driving value through common processes and global ways of working across Diageo in a more consistent and efficient manner, maximizing the benefits that SAP tools like S/4, APO or BW bring to the organization.

This role will support the standardisation and automation of the process streams led by DBS and will be responsible for the execution of the analysis, design and overall end to end delivery of Application Changes in SAP and supporting the Business Partners in delivering the IS agenda for their streams.

Significant cross-functional working is required, particularly across IS, Governance, End to End Commercial, Source to Pay, Financial Controlling, Procurement and Supply to continue the great steps forward that have been achieved in recent years. SAP Functional Consultant will need to work across these areas, in addition to DBS and all in market companies, by connecting with the global communities to facilitate changes in the process and ongoing improvements.

This role will support the delivery of changes in the OTC (Order to Cash) in the SAP Functional CoE. This covers areas like Order management, Shipping, Billing & Returns processes . The chosen person will need to have a very strong background in SAP ECC in these modules as well as knowledge of these modules in SAP S4HANA.

The role will work in partnership with the project team and other resources from the SAP CoE.

**Purpose of Role**

The purpose of this role is

* To participate in the end-to-end delivery of changes in Order to Cash.
* To support current & future projects in the SAP S/4 SD
* To bring **experience in SAP S4HANA**, **BTP IS**
* To add knowledge of **SAP Fiori apps**
* To support the Business Partner or the Project Manager/Programme Director, leading in the areas of functionality, process, information and data analysis within this area
* To become a subject matter expert in their process area bringing competitive and industry best practise analysis and provide recommendation for specific investment in collaboration with the process experts
* Interact with external partners working on delivering SAP changes which could include technical resources (e.g. coders) and testers
* Provide when called upon subject matter expertise to the business and project team
* To support continued improvement within the area process through an efficient and effective delivery by meeting targets on time, defect free, solutions

**Top 5 Accountabilities**

**Participation and delivery of -**

**1. High Level Definition** – estimation of complexity and work required to deliver a given change

**2. Functional definition, governance and translation to system requirements** – Identify and document global business functionalities, information and data gaps, gap solutions and match functionality to enable market solutioning and system configuration. Ensure proper documentation is in place according to Diageo standards. Act as a Consultant in process improvement, knowledge base development and change implementation planning if required

**3. System governance and configuration** – Ensuring that we design and deliver solutions that fit with our Enterprise Architecture and technical roadmaps, both from a design perspective and as the person configuring them

**4. Solution Knowledge** – builds effective knowledge of all solutions delivered to enable internal ongoing BAU capabilities

**5. Security and compliance** – make sure that all delivered solutions follow Diageo global security guidelines and controls (e.g. CARM)

**Working with us**  
  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

***Recruitment Scam Warning***

*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

Regular

Bangalore Karle Town SEZ

**Your Role**

As a BIM Coordinator for Data Centre p rojects, you will coordinate BIM and digital delivery across several concurrent critical facilities projects, with a primary focus on multidisciplinary model coordination, information exchange and issue resolution.

Reporting to the BIM Manager, you will take direct ownership of day-to-day model federation, clash detection, coordination issue tracking and BIM coordination reporting. You will provide coordination direction to BIM Specialists and BIM Modellers and ensure modelling and coordination activities follow agreed BIM standards, project workflows and delivery milestones. This is a hands-on role helping teams manage dense multidisciplinary models, phased packages, evolving design information, model exchanges, and critical equipment and service interfaces.

Based in our Mumbai office, you will be part of a distributed APME project delivery team. You will work with design and project teams across different offices and maintain sufficient working-hour overlap to receive instructions, resolve queries and coordinate priorities effectively. You will also work very closely with the Regional Design Technology team to bring the innovation, standards, and automation the firm is developing into your Centre of Excellence.

  

**Professional Traits**

* You take pride in the detail of your work and are your own most honest critic, never satisfied with something you know could be better.
* You are patient and curious when faced with technical complexity, and would rather understand why something behaves as it does than work around it.
* You are dependable, self-directed, with genuine ownership of your work and a strong sense of accountability.
* You are collaborative and enjoy developing others, sharing what you know and helping the people around you grow.
You have a genuine appetite to learn, and you are open to new digital-delivery methods, automation and continuous improvement.  

  

**What You Will Do**

* Implement project BIM workflows using Autodesk Revit Architecture, Navisworks Manage, Autodesk Construction Cloud/Forma, and other approved coordination platforms.

* Contribute to BIM Execution Plans and support ISO 19650-aligned workflows, specifically coordination protocol and clash detection/resolution.
* Maintain federated models integrating all stakeholder models; run routine health reviews and report concerns to responsible parties.
* Configure Navisworks coordination environments, including clash tests, search and selection sets, viewpoints, grouping methods, and reporting structures.
* Run regular clash detection, remove duplicates and false positives, prioritise issues, assign responsible disciplines, and track to closeout, helping design leaders and consultants resolve design and modelling conflicts.
* Run routine coordination meetings with consultants and contractors; support the BIM Manager in workshops and project meetings.
* Prepare and issue registers, meeting actions, clash reports, coordination dashboards, model-status reports, and milestone BIM updates.
Coordinate fabrication, vendor, contractor, point-cloud, and specialist model information.  

  

**Your Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Engineering, Architectural Technology, Construction, or a related built-environment discipline.
* 7–10 years of BIM and digital delivery experience, including demonstrated responsibility for multidisciplinary BIM coordination on complex projects.
* Experience with data centres, critical facilities, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor, industrial, or similar services-intensive projects.
* Strong Autodesk Revit capability, including model setup, worksharing , coordinates, and collaboration processes.
* Advanced Navisworks Manage knowledge covering federation, clash detection and grouping, viewpoints, reporting, and issue closeout.
* Strong working knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud/Forma for collaboration, document management, model coordination, issues, and information exchange.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating architectural, structural, MEP, fire protection, technology, and specialist systems.
* Experience leading BIM coordination meetings and managing actions across multiple disciplines.
* Experience working with geographically distributed or international project teams.
* Working knowledge of BIM Execution Plans, LOD/LOI, model standards, quality control, Common Data Environment principles, ISO 19650, and stage-gate model handover.
Strong, proactive communication in clear written and spoken English, within your own team and across the wider regional team, with the organisational and time-management skills to work effectively across time zones.

**Additional Skills**
